_about: Assumptions for the drawing-to-quote estimate and the carbon comparison. Every figure is an ESTIMATE for the course prototype, to be replaced by Omega's own rates before any real quote. Sources are listed per figure.

wire_mm.source: Omega website: wire from 0.5 to 25 mm

carbon_steel.label: Carbon steel for cold heading (C10C / 1.0214)
carbon_steel.source: kgCO2/kg: electric-arc steel, typical of Italy (89% EAF, Federacciai via the team research); price: indicative wire-rod price

stainless.label: Stainless steel (AISI 304 / 1.4301)
stainless.source: kgCO2/kg: ISSF global average for austenitic stainless (estimate); price: indicative

aluminium.label: Aluminium (6061 / 6082)
aluminium.source: kgCO2/kg: European primary aluminium average (estimate); price: indicative

brass.label: Brass (CuZn37)
brass.source: kgCO2/kg: estimate for brass with recycled content; price: indicative

forming.source: Indicative rates for a multi-station header in Lombardy; to be replaced by Omega's

machining.source: Turning from bar of the part's largest diameter; energy per kg removed is an estimate

electricity_source: Italian grid average, about 0.25 kgCO2/kWh (ISPRA, estimate)
